bullets: If X ∈ class I and misclassified as Class II then d(X) will be <0 ⇒ δ_i = -1 ⇒ d(X) δ_i >0

Minimize the Error using Gradient Descent with step η

W^(updated) = W^old - η Σ_{misclassified vectors ONLY (i)} δ_i X_i
